picks.headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
picks.why: It delivers up to 8x faster token generation for high-throughput API, Codex, and enterprise workloads.
picks.title: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast

picks.headline: Meta Implements Jagged Flash Attention on Blackwell GPUs via TLX
picks.why: It outperforms FlashAttention-4 on NVIDIA B200 GPUs while requiring three times fewer lines of code.
picks.title: Optimizing Jagged Flash Attention with TLX: The Road Toward SOTA FA4 on Blackwell

picks.headline: Covert Exfiltration Channel Exploits LLM Web-Fetching Tools
picks.why: Malware can exfiltrate secrets from restricted environments by tricking agents into requesting secret-encoded URLs.
picks.title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching

picks.headline: Adversarial Skill Chains Hijack Downstream LLM Agent Actions
picks.why: The APEX technique passes fake approval claims across skill task records to force agents into unapproved actions.
picks.title: Chaining Skills to Hijack LLM Agents

picks.headline: PACE Mediates LLM Agent Tool Execution via Path Confinement
picks.why: It provides pre-execution capability enforcement to stop unauthorized agent tool calls before they run.
picks.title: PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents

picks.headline: Black-Box Extraction Attack Exposes Multimodal RAG Datastores
picks.why: Embedded image instructions can force multimodal RAG models to reconstruct and leak hidden retrieval datastores.
picks.title: Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG

papers.headline: RLVR Post-Training Inherently Causes Unbounded Language Drift in CoT
papers.why: Proves theoretically and empirically that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards systematically degrades chain-of-thought reasoning readability.
papers.title: On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training

papers.headline: MCMC On-Policy Sampling Enables SFT to Match Reinforcement Learning
papers.why: Shows that converting off-policy traces into on-policy data allows supervised fine-tuning to equal or exceed RL performance.
papers.title: Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think

papers.headline: MF-1 Replaces Discrete Visual Tokens with Continuous Flow Matching
papers.why: Introduces unified continuous generative modeling over joint vision-language embedding spaces, eliminating discrete visual tokens.
papers.title: Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces
